nodes.description: _owner: privileged owner address set in constructor; guards onlyOwner functions
_rOwned: reflection balance mapping, mutated by _transferStandard and _takeTeam
_allowances: ERC20 allowance mapping written by _approve
_isExcludedFromFee: fee-exemption mapping consulted in _transfer
bots: blacklist mapping toggled by onlyOwner setBots/delBot and checked in _transfer
cooldown: per-address timestamp gate written in _transfer
_rTotal: total reflections supply, reduced by _reflectFee
_feeAddrWallet1: payable fee receiver, also the auth check address for manualswap/manualsend
_feeAddrWallet2: payable fee receiver
uniswapV2Router: router interface used for swaps and liquidity provision
uniswapV2Pair: pair address created in openTrading and used as swap trigger
tradingOpen: one-time gate set in openTrading
inSwap: swap reentrancy guard flag toggled by lockTheSwap
swapEnabled: enables automatic token-to-ETH swap inside _transfer
cooldownEnabled: toggles the cooldown branch in _transfer; set by setCooldownEnabled
_maxTxAmount: per-transaction cap enforced in _transfer
constructor: sets fee wallets, mints rTotal to msg.sender, sets fee exemptions
transfer: external ERC20 entry that forwards to _transfer with msg.sender
transferFrom: external ERC20 entry performing _transfer plus allowance decrement
approve: external ERC20 entry writing _allowances
_transfer: core internal transfer logic with blacklist, cooldown, fee and auto-swap branches
swapTokensForEth: approves router and performs external swap under lockTheSwap
sendETHToFee: splits ETH balance and pushes it to both fee wallets
openTrading: onlyOwner setup of router, pair, liquidity and trading flags
setBots: onlyOwner loop marking addresses as bots
delBot: onlyOwner removal from the blacklist
manualswap: fee-wallet-only function that swaps the contract token balance
manualsend: fee-wallet-only function that forwards contract ETH to fee wallets
_tokenTransfer: thin internal wrapper that calls _transferStandard
_transferStandard: mutates reflection balances and distributes fees
_takeTeam: credits the team fee into the contract reflection balance
_reflectFee: reduces _rTotal and grows _tFeeTotal
_getValues: computes reflective amounts from tAmount
_getRate: divides reflection supply by token supply
setCooldownEnabled: onlyOwner toggle for the cooldown feature
renounceOwnership: onlyOwner function clearing _owner
balanceOf: view converting reflection balance to token balance
_approve: internal allowance writer with zero-address checks
tokenFromReflection: divides reflection amount by current rate
msg.sender: attacker-controlled caller used for auth, approvals and transfers
block.timestamp: miner-influenced value used for cooldown and swap deadlines
uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens: external call re-entering with contract state partly updated
uniswapV2Router.addLiquidityETH with full contract ETH balance: external payable call
_feeAddrWallet.transfer(amount): external ETH push executed after balance reads
IUniswapV2Factory.createPair: external call whose result becomes uniswapV2Pair
IERC20(uniswapV2Pair).approve(router, type(uint).max): unlimited external approval
_rOwned[sender].sub(rAmount): arithmetic balance decrement on fee/reflection math
_rTotal.sub(rFee): arithmetic supply decrement in _reflectFee
receive() external payable: contract accepts arbitrary ETH from any sender
_transfer parameter from
_transfer parameter to
_transfer parameter amount
_transfer local contractTokenBalance
_transfer local contractETHBalance
swapTokensForEth parameter tokenAmount
sendETHToFee parameter amount
_transferStandard parameter tAmount
_transferStandard parameter sender
_transferStandard parameter recipient
team fee portion computed in _getValues and forwarded to _takeTeam
currentRate read from _getRate in _takeTeam/_getValues
approve parameter spender
setBots parameter bots_ array
rAmount computed in _getRValues and subtracted in _transferStandard
rFee computed in _getRValues and subtracted in _reflectFee
